notes.title: HotFix v0.31# Gamer Stop Simulator 13.06.2025
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Thank You! ❤️[/b][/h1]

A huge thank you to everyone who has played the Gamer Stop Simulator demo and added it to their wishlist! Your support means the world to us and keeps us motivated every day. 🙏

We were aware of some issues from day one, and our team jumped into action right away to address them. We're working hard to improve the experience and make Gamer Stop Simulator the best it can be. 

Today, we’re releasing a hotfix update to improve your experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597021/f2f9f92848ed45087b23b8d9bb3583c4171b4559.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]HotFix Notes 🔥[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Second-hand AI behaviors fixed: Issues related to AI logic in the second-hand trade system have been resolved.

[*] Customer interaction bugs fixed: Fixed cases where customers could get stuck or become unresponsive during interactions.

[*] Save system improvements:

[*] Fixed issues where saved products, paint colors, second shelf data, and other items were not loading properly.

[*] Overall save reliability and consistency improved.

[*] Language issues resolved: Fixed localization and translation problems affecting multiple UI elements.

[*] Second-hand trade interactions fixed: Resolved problems where players couldn’t interact with AIs during second-hand purchases or sales.

[*] Cash register customer bugs fixed: Fixed interaction issues with customers at the checkout counter.

[/list]
